title: Antarctic Ice Marathon — official home page, 2026 edition
claims: The 2026 Antarctic Ice Marathon is the 21st edition and is scheduled for 13 December 2026 at Union Glacier, Antarctica.
The official home page gives the marathon as 26.2 miles, latitude 80°S, typical temperature -20 °C and 24 hours of daylight.
The official home page lists the men's event record as 2:53:33 (Sean Tobin, 2022) and the women's event record as 3:29:16 (Liesl Muehlhauser, 2024).
The event has had 20 editions since the 2005/2006 Antarctic season and 1,030 global finishers across all distances since 2005.
The 2026 entry fee is USD 22,500 and includes round-trip flights from Punta Arenas to Union Glacier, food and accommodation in Antarctica, and race entry.
